stories.title: Doden busongeluk Zwitserland zijn vier vrouwen en een man; eerste gewonden dit weekeinde gerepatrieerd

en.title: Bus accident deaths in Switzerland are four women and one man; first injured repatriated this weekend
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in Switzerland on Thursday. The victims consist of four women and one man, all over 70 years old, from various locations in the Netherlands.

stories.title: Céline Dion zet Parijs op z'n kop met concertreeks die een tijd onmogelijk leek

en.title: Céline Dion shakes up Paris with concert series that seemed impossible for a time
en.summary: Céline Dion makes her comeback performance in Paris on Saturday, her first concert since 2020. The concert series is a significant achievement given her recent health challenges.

stories.title: Noord-Korea vuurt ballistische raketten richting zee na militaire oefening VS

en.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles toward sea following US military exercise
en.summary: North Korea launched ballistic missiles toward the sea on Saturday following a joint military exercise conducted by the United States, Japan, and South Korea.

stories.title: Doden busongeluk Zwitserland zijn vier vrouwen en een man, allen ouder dan 70

en.title: Bus accident deaths in Switzerland are four women and one man, all over 70
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in Switzerland on Thursday. All victims are over 70 years old and originate from different parts of the Netherlands.

stories.title: Vier vrouwen en een man dodelijke slachtoffers busongeluk Zwitserland

en.title: Four women and one man killed in bus accident in Switzerland
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in eastern Switzerland on Thursday. The victims were women aged 71, 79, 80, and 75, and a man aged 75. Forty other passengers were injured, with ten in serious condition.

stories.title: Problemen voor Saoedi-Arabië stapelen zich op: oliepijpleiding dicht na droneaanval vanuit Irak

en.title: Problems mounting for Saudi Arabia: oil pipeline shut after drone attack from Iraq
en.summary: An oil pipeline was closed following a drone attack originating from Iraq, adding to mounting difficulties for Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: CIA geeft rond herdenking 9/11 topgeheime waarschuwingen over Bin Laden vrij

en.title: CIA releases top secret warnings about Bin Laden around 9/11 commemoration
en.summary: The CIA released 71 classified presidential daily briefs during the 25th anniversary of 9/11, documenting warnings about Al-Qaeda threats leading up to the attacks. The documents show an escalating pattern of security warnings but contain no major revelations.

stories.title: Auto botst op tankstation Hoorn: inzittende overleden en bestuurder aangehouden

en.title: Car crashes into gas station in Hoorn: occupant killed and driver arrested
en.summary: A car struck a gas station in Hoorn late Friday night and caught fire, killing one of four occupants and injuring two others. The driver was detained on suspicion of driving under the influence.

stories.title: Parijs maakt zich op voor comeback Céline Dion: 'Opgetogen, maar ook bezorgd'

en.title: Paris prepares for Céline Dion's comeback: 'Excited, but also concerned'
en.summary: Paris is experiencing a wave of enthusiasm ahead of Céline Dion's long-awaited concert series beginning tonight, with special merchandise, karaoke events, and increased travel bookings. Dion, who disclosed in 2022 that she has a rare neurological condition, is making her return to live performance.

stories.title: Wekdienst 12/9: Klimaatmars in Amsterdam • Comeback Céline Dion in Parijs

en.title: Wake-up service 12/9: Climate march in Amsterdam • Céline Dion's comeback in Paris
en.summary: A climate march is scheduled in Amsterdam and Céline Dion's concert series begins in Paris tonight. Expect gray skies with mist in the morning, clearing to sun later, with temperatures reaching 20 to 22 degrees and no rain expected.

stories.title: Auto rijdt tegen tankstation in Hoorn en vliegt in brand, inzittende dood

en.title: Car crashes into gas station in Hoorn and catches fire, occupant killed
en.summary: A car collided with a gas station in Hoorn early this morning, caught fire, and killed one occupant while injuring two others. The driver was arrested for driving under the influence.

stories.title: Zuid-Korea meldt afvuren ballistische raketten richting zee door Noord-Korea

en.title: South Korea reports North Korea fires ballistic missiles toward sea
en.summary: North Korea launched ballistic missiles from its eastern coast toward the Sea of Japan, traveling approximately 250 kilometers according to South Korean military reports. South Korea's government condemned the action as a violation of UN Security Council resolutions.
